title: High-Dimensional Spectral Limits for Gaussian KL-Unbalanced Optimal Transport
summary: We study high-dimensional random-matrix limits of Gaussian Kullback--Leibler unbalanced optimal transport (KL-UOT). Under equal marginal penalties, the covariance action admits an exact log-determinant representation in terms of a nonlinear ridge product, together with a positive-semidefinite extension that remains finite at arbitrary aspect ratios.
